facts.rationale: Replaces the obsolete rules.x50 field reference with the canonical on_match_end field while retaining the verified shared-state flow.
facts.value: All-Star Rest Area setup stores this function in StartMeleeData.rules.on_match_end through a void (*)(u8) cast. The function itself is void(int), ignores its argument, and forwards 0x78 to lbBgFlash_8002063C. That routine replaces the shared transition endpoints and current color, computes per-frame channel deltas, and selects the transition mode.

facts.value: Starts Melee's All-Star campaign by resetting run state, selecting each opponent record's configured stage, shuffling the first 24 opponent records while preserving the final position, and entering character select. Stage selection calls HSD_Randi(2), but every candidate-stage pair currently contains identical values, so this selection does not produce distinct stage variants. The fixed final position feeds the dedicated Mr. Game & Watch encounter.

Candidate-stage selection consumes randomness, but the current equal-valued pairs do not vary each record's stage.
